patterns: Agents beat tools: EHuanglu's 'one-person company with 100s of AI agents' clip exploded (442K views, 2.2K bookmarks, 3.5K likes) with a one-line caption, and minchoi's Grok Bot phone-call post added 8.6K. The 'AI does the work for you' story outran every creative clip.

Seedance 2.5 is the creative engine of the day: techhalla's Frozen + reverse Seedance prompt (9.6K, 125 bookmarks) and azed_ai's 'The hat thief' with Seedance 2.5 on Dreamina (8.6K) both cleared the floor.
Promise the method, hold it back: AIWarper's 'Comment "Higgsfield will steal this idea..." to learn more' hook pulled 23.7K views and 82 replies, the best reply ratio of the day.
Prompt shares keep the bookmark ratio: azed_ai's ink wash prompt share (5.9K views, 120 bookmarks) and techhalla's 'prompt is below' post saved at 1.3-2%, far above clips without a prompt.

CharaspowerAI's Firefly multi-genre showreel test reached 98K views but only 18 likes, so reach there likely came from distribution rather than organic engagement; the format (scattered footage into one 60-90s reel) is still worth testing.

drafts.draft_en:
I run a one-person AI VFX studio.

No crew. One agent breaks down the script, one generates the plates, one handles the cleanup pass.

Here's what a single shot looks like from brief to final 👇
drafts.video_tip: 10-12s split screen: left side shows the agent task list ticking off (script, plates, cleanup), right side shows the shot building up layer by layer and ending on the final frame. One caption line, no voiceover.

drafts.draft_en:
I gave Firefly 6 clips that have nothing in common.

A desert chase, a rooftop fight, a car crash, a storm, a spaceship, a sword duel.

It cut them into one trailer. Watch the transitions 💥
drafts.video_tip: 30-45s: flash the 6 unrelated source clips as a 1-second grid, then play the stitched trailer at full screen. Put the hard transitions on the beat; end on the title card.

drafts.draft_en:
Frozen in time, then played in reverse ❄️⏪

One Seedance 2.5 prompt, one take, no editing.

Full prompt below, steal it.
drafts.video_tip: 6-8s: the explosion freezes mid-air for one beat, the camera drifts through the frozen debris, then everything rewinds back to the start. Prompt in the first reply.
